gloss: to decline; to turn down; to withdraw

definitions.gloss: to decline; to turn down; to withdraw
definitions.explanation: To politely refuse an offer, honor, or opportunity. Also used when withdrawing from a competition, candidacy, or position. More formal than {断|ことわ}る and implies a respectful refusal.

examples.japanese: {出席|しゅっせき}を{辞退|じたい}する。
{体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}のため、{大会|たいかい}への{出場|しゅつじょう}を{辞退|じたい}した。
examples.english: Due to poor health, I withdrew from the tournament.

examples.japanese: せっかくのご{招待|しょうたい}ですが、{今回|こんかい}は{辞退|じたい}させていただきます。
examples.english: Thank you for the kind invitation, but I must decline this time.

notes: A formal, polite way to refuse. Common collocations: {出席|しゅっせき}を{辞退|じたい}する (decline to attend), {受賞|じゅしょう}を{辞退|じたい}する (decline an award), {候補|こうほ}を{辞退|じたい}する (withdraw one's candidacy). The polite form {辞退|じたい}させていただきます is frequently used in business and formal situations. Distinguished from {断|ことわ}る (to refuse, more direct and everyday) and {遠慮|えんりょ}する (to hold back, softer and more about self-restraint).
